snippet.title: Fishu - Cozy Fishing Adventure | Early Gameplay Showcase
snippet.description:
Dive into Fishu, a cozy fishing adventure game where you explore charming locations, catch a wide variety of fish, discover rare creatures, upgrade your fishing gear, and uncover secrets hidden beneath the surface.

-  Catch and discover fish
-  Explore different fishing locations
-  Upgrade your rods and baits
-  Collect rare treasures and hidden items
-  Fill your Fish Codex
-  Play solo or with friends online

Everything shown in this video is only a small part of the content planned for the final version of Fishu. The game is still actively in development, and many of the features, visuals, environments, and systems shown here will continue to evolve.

Add Fishu to your Steam wishlist:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4768750/Fishu/
